TITLE: An Index of Unsent Messages
TEXT:
INDEX — UNSENT MESSAGES

#001  "Hey" (too small to carry the longing)
#014  "Can we talk?" (filed under: fear)
#022  "I miss you" (duplicate copies; coffee stains)
#031  "I'm proud of you" (kept for later; later never arrived)
#044  "Stop" (written, deleted, written again)
#058  "Thank you" (unsent due to embarrassment)

Archivist’s note:
Some messages are not unsent.
They are seeds.
They wait for weather.
